provenance: Locally generated synthetic self-play only. No user games, external datasets, third-party weights, sampled-truth labels, or search-score labels.

generation.policy: Current HCE only. First 8 plies: seeded uniform choice among top 3 completed ranked candidates, then best completed candidate. Tie-break by from then to. Policy RNG independent of layout seed; native sampling seed solely observationSeed(publicState(state, state.turn)).
generation.clock: Fixed depth and deterministic node limit, one search at a time. Wall-clock timeout, stack-safety cutoff, incomplete first iteration, illegal move, or protocol failure is a technical failure, never a training example.
generation.rule: Terminal mate/stalemate first; third identical public board and turn loses for mover; 120 quiet plies draw; 400-ply cap unresolved unless an earlier-priority terminal condition applies.
generation.stopRule: Generate exactly the frozen 48 games. Preserve all failures and unresolved results; no replacement layouts, retries, outcome quotas, or result-dependent tuning. Resume incomplete games from their public journals.

data.split: SHA256(JSON.stringify(true initial board)) is the grouping identity only. First 16 prescribed seeds train, next 4 validation, final 4 test. All policy games for a layout stay together.
data.labels: Independently replayed terminal outcome only: red win 1, black win 0, 120-quiet draw 0.5.
data.weighting: Equal total weight per eligible initial layout, equal eligible games within layout, equal pre-move viewpoint observations within game. Missing/failed groups are reported, never backfilled.
data.modelInput: Only existing 2597 sparse lawful observation features and HCE base score. No layout hash, seed, journal, ply, future move/capture, or search output.

training.selection: Lowest validation weighted BCE among epochs 1..120, ties retain earlier epoch; freeze float32 model before opening test file, then evaluate test once.

matches.stopRule: Complete all paired held-out matches with frozen weights and equal clocks; no tuning after any test or match outcome.

publication: Only checked isolated experiment code, synthetic reproducibility evidence, and model under the user-authorized publication workflow. No default engine changes.
